source: PBC individual monthly LPR announcements, reformed mechanism from 2019-08-20
availability: max(announcement date, displayed publication date) + 1 natural day; sensitivity 7 and 30 days
signal: mean of 1y and 5y LPR is below its as-of-known level 90 natural days ago; no interpolation or pre-reform backfill

stock_budgets.easing_confirmed_vol10: 50% only if recent LPR reduction and price quality > 0, otherwise 40%
stock_budgets.easing_caution_vol10: 30% only if recent LPR reduction and price quality < 0, otherwise 40%

remaining: equal bond funds, per-fund cap 90%; same past-only 10% projected-volatility constraint for all policies
fees: normal buy/sell 10bps each scenario; redemption under 7 confirmation natural days at least 150bps
stress: fee50/100bps, phases2/5/7, execution lag2, announcement lag7/30days
historical_limits: Already-viewed fund histories, current survivor lists, no untouched independent forward sample; displayed PBC timestamps remain conditional availability evidence

followup_controls.static50_vol10: fixed 50% stock, 20% gold, remaining bonds, identical volatility and execution constraints
followup_controls.static30_vol10: fixed 30% stock, 20% gold, remaining bonds, identical volatility and execution constraints
followup_controls.purpose: Separate timing value from simply using more or less equity; not a new untouched validation sample
